buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Inspection Pre-dispatch inspection at Seller premises (Fee/Charges to be borne by the BUYER): Before dispatch, the goods will be inspected by Buyer / Consignee or their Authorized Representative or by Nominated External Inspection Agency (independently or jointly with Buyer or Consignee as decided by the Buyer) at Seller premises (or at designated place for inspection as declared / communicated by the seller) for their compliance to the contract specifications. Fee/Charges taken by the External inspection Agency and any external laboratories testing charges shall be borne by the Buyer. For in-house testing, the Sellers will provide necessary facilities free of cost. Seller shall notify the Buyer through e-mail about readiness of goods for pre-dispatch inspection and Buyer will notify the Seller about the Authorized Representative/ Nominated External Inspection Agency and the date for testing. The goods would be dispatched to consignee only after clearance in pre-dispatch inspection. Consignee's right of rejection as per GTC in respect of the goods finally received at his location shall in no way be limited or waived by reason of the goods having previously been inspected, tested and passed by Buyer/ Consignee or its Nominated External Inspection Agency prior to the goods' shipment. While bidding, the sellers should take into account 7 days for inspection from the date of email offering the goods for inspection. Any delay in inspection beyond 7 days shall be on the part of the buyer and shall be regularised without Liquidated Damages. When there is requirement of submission the advance sample, the seller shall inform the buyer promptly through emails about the date of submission of sample to the buyer nominated Inspection agency. 2. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Special Terms and Conditions (STC) 1. Authorization Centres in Haryana The bidder/manufacturer must have at least four (4) authorized service centres in the State of Haryana to ensure proper after-sales service, maintenance and availability of spare parts. 2. Delivery of Tractors The successful bidder shall ensure delivery of tractors at the respective villages in Mahendergarh District, Haryana, as per the village-wise list attached with the tender document (PDF). No additional transportation

or delivery charges shall be payable by the purchaser. 3. Inclusive Quoted Rates The rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of the following: Basic cost of the tractor. Insurance charges. Registration charges. Legending/lettering charges, as specified by the department. Transportation and delivery charges up to the respective village locations. No additional payment on account of the above items shall be admissible. 4. Submission of Sample Mini Tractor for Inspection and Approval The successful bidder shall produce/show a sample of the offered Mini Tractor within five (5) days from the date of issuance of the Supply Order for inspection and approval by the Competent Authority/Authorized C ommittee. In case the firm fails to produce/show the sample within the stipulated period of five (5) days, the Supply O rder shall be liable to be cancelled. Further, the Bank Guarantee and Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall b e liable to be forfeited, in accordance with applicable rules and GeM Terms & Conditions, besides taking an y other action permissible under applicable Government instructions. . 6. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 7.
